children: Lamar Advertising raised its quarterly dividend by 3.1%, to $1.65 a share, from $1.60.
The new payout, equal to $6.60 a year, represents an annual yield of about 4.4% based on Tuesday's closing price of $151.08.
The dividend is payable on Sept. 30 to stockholders of record on Sept. 21, the outdoor advertising company said.
